info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Features:  Call Park API
Read the List of Call Parks

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return the list of call parks for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: List call parks for this organization.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of call parks returned to this maximum count. Default is 2000.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching call parks. Default is 0.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort the list of call parks by name, either ASC or DSC. Default is ASC.

params.name: name
params.description: Return the list of call parks that contains the given name. The maximum length is 80.

items.docs:
List all Call Parks for the organization.

Call Park allows call recipients to place a call on hold so that it can be retrieved from another device.

Retrieving this list requires a full or read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

**NOTE**: The Call Park ID will change upon modification of the Call Park name.

params.description: Return the available agents for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Return the available agents for this organization.

params.name: callParkName
params.description: Only return available agents from call parks with the matching name.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of available agents returned to this maximum count.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching available agents.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return available agents with the matching name.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Only return available agents with the matching primary number.

params.name: order
params.description: Order the available agents according to the designated fields. Up to three vertical bar (|) separated sort order fields may be specified. Available sort fields: fname, lname, number and extension. The maximum supported sort order value is 3.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching objects.

params.name: extension
params.description: Only return call park extensions with the matching extension.

params.name: locationName
params.description: Only return call park extensions with the matching extension.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return call park extensions with the matching name.

params.name: order
params.description: Order the available agents according to the designated fields.  Available sort fields: `groupName`, `callParkExtension`, `callParkExtensionName`, `callParkExtensionExternalId`.

items.docs:
List all Call Park Extensions for the organization.

The Call Park service, enabled for all users by default, allows a user to park a call against an available user's extension or to a Call Park Extension. Call Park Extensions are extensions defined within the Call Park service for holding parked calls.

Retrieving this list requires a full or read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

Update the designated Call Park Extension.
